name: a-real-extension-chip-opens-its-native-menu
description: A real unpacked extension, loaded with --load-extension and pinned through the seeded Preferences, shows its chip in the sidebar strip. A right-click on that chip opens the native extension menu, which adds a window.

actions.note: gate: the startup tab committed, so the app is up
THE MEASUREMENT: the loaded and pinned extension has a chip in the strip

actions.expression: (() => { const c = document.querySelector('.exs-chip[data-extension-id="ockdpgepnciealdnaddnkfcnbieickai"]'); if (!c) { return 'no-chip'; } const b = c.getBoundingClientRect(); return Math.round((b.left + b.right) / 2) + ',' + Math.round((b.top + b.bottom) / 2 + 30); })()
actions.note: the chip's centre on screen, 30px below its client y

assertions.desc: the real extension's chip shows in the sidebar strip
the browser window and the native extension menu
